title: Base change of a formally unramified morphism is formally unramified
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a formally unramified morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-formally-unramified-morphism] and $g:S'\to S$ any morphism of schemes. Let $X'=X\times_SS'$ be the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product] with projection $f':X'\to S'$. Then $f'$ is formally unramified [def-weil-pbc-formally-unramified-morphism].
